items.problem: Agent wrapped OnNavigatedTo bodies in try/catch as if that would resolve the build failures, instead of fixing the compile errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 56 edit adds try/catch around OnNavigatedTo in Scenario4 while leaving Application.Suspending/Resuming and the missing PHY members in place.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md 'Defensive UI for init-heavy and device-dependent pages' explicitly frames try/catch as a RUNTIME guard against blank frames, never as a build-error fix; Step 3 says to fetch the matching anchor for a build error.
items.why_no_skill_change: The skill already scopes try/catch to runtime init failures; a capable model would not use it to mask compile errors. However, the underlying compile errors themselves were NOT covered — those are handled as skill-defects (Suspending/Resuming + member stubbing), which removes the temptation to misapply try/catch in the first place. No additional slip-specific skill edit is warranted.
